chainFacts.says: Token-2022 with pausable, scaled-UI amount, confidential-transfer mint, a transfer hook initialised with no program, default account state not frozen and no permanent delegate. Mint, pause and multiplier sit with a PDA of the upgradeable Ondo GM program, whose upgrade sits with a 4-of-7 Squads vault with a 7,200-second time lock; freeze sits with a 3-of-8 Squads vault with no time lock; emergency pause with a 1-of-9 vault.
chainFacts.source: RWA Sonar dossier keyGovernance and authorityFacts (finalized RPC reads 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-24)

chainFacts.says: The multiplier differs from 1 on 156 of the 268 live mints, written through the program on the instruction of one hot key.
The freeze authority has five transactions in its history, including one freezeAccount and one thawAccount between 2026-04-27 and 2026-05-01.

Redemption burns the token: 219 direct redemptions by 6 whitelisted wallets across 101 tokens paid USD 49,041.87 in USDC between 2026-09-22T23:31Z and 2026-09-23T18:18Z, one wallet making 132 of them.

outside.says: Onboarded Purchasers only, for USDon or USDC against an Ondo-signed secp256k1 quote, 24/5 (24/7 for a named subset), with Purchaser Fees of up to 0.1% and Ondo keeping the spread; physical delivery excluded. Alpaca's ITN lets authorised participants redeem in kind on Ethereum and BNB Chain only. Stays in the Sales Terms and onboarding.

The Tokenizer may freeze, rescind transfers made in breach of the Sales Terms, cancel tokens 'with or without making any payment therefor', pause, and execute orders of courts recognised in the BVI; the issuer may replace the Underlying or call and redeem a whole series. Only freeze and pause are wired on chain.

Primary-market quotes derive from the NYSE or NASDAQ price and are checked on chain against a last_price written by an Ondo key, not a Pyth equity feed; Pyth checks only the USDC leg. Secondary DEX liquidity is thin.

Swiss law for the tokens and Sales Terms, with Swiss Rules arbitration seated in Zurich; New York law for the Collateral Agreement and the Alpaca control agreement, South Dakota law for BitGo's, Delaware law for the Administrative Services Agreement. Sold under Regulation S only.
Since 2026-04-28 holders can send non-binding voting preferences through Broadridge; the issuer need not follow them.

verdict.summary: A/H/T, a security interest and a dated coverage status give the outline, and Ankura's daily report is the rare third-party figure published under its own name. But the token cannot be read (Token-2022), the security interest cannot name the holders of a token type as a class, coverage is pooled across products and chains with no per-type allocation, and 'issuer-obligation' hides a secured note that a non-onboarded holder cannot redeem. The custodians publish nothing themselves.
